Facts: Use of pseudo base station (伪基站) to send fraudulent SMS impersonating banks, to lure victims. They sold device, hired people to send SMS, got payment. They knowingly sent fraudulent messages. This is likely "诈骗罪" (fraud) but specifically "利用信息网络实施诈骗" maybe "诈骗罪" or "非法获取公用电信设施" or "破坏计算机信息系统"? Here they used pseudo base station to send fraudulent SMS. That is "非法获取公用电信设施罪" (illegal acquisition of public telecommunication facilities) or "破坏公用电信设施罪". Also "诈骗罪" (fraud) because they sent fraudulent messages to obtain money from victims (though not proven victims). The court may consider "诈骗罪" using telecom network. In Chinese law, there is "利用信息网络实施诈骗罪" (Article 266). Also "非法获取公用电信设施罪" (Article 110 of Criminal Law). The facts: they used pseudo base station to send messages, which is illegal use of telecom facilities. They also engaged in fraud (sending fraudulent messages). The earlier example with pseudo base station used to send fraudulent SMS: they labeled as "破坏计算机信息系统" for other case (fishing game). But here it's telecom. So likely crimes: "诈骗罪" and "非法获取公用电信设施罪".
